content.text: {"headline":"Approve P3: overtime for 14 payments agents 12:00-13:00, plus chat deflection, delayed payments breaks and payments callback. Predicted service level is 81.7% for 11:30-14:45 at ₹2,028.","why":"Payments handle time has risen from about 296 s to 556 s while volume is only modestly up. The likely cause is the slow chargeback/dispute screens (INC-20261118-1085), but that link is not confirmed. With no action, service level over the disruption window is predicted at 75.8% (payments 70.0%). P3 is the cheapest policy-compliant plan that reaches the 80% target, at 81.7% overall (payments 80.0%, general 83.7%). Abandon rate falls to 4.6% from 5.7%, and the rest-of-day figure improves to 90.0%.","trade_offs":["P2 costs ₹624 against ₹2,028 for P3, but reaches only 79.1% (payments 76.6%), just short of target.","P1 costs nothing but performs worse than doing nothing: 73.9%, with general dropping to 78.5% and abandons at 6.2%.","P4 is ₹132 dearer and reaches a similar 81.5%. It leaves payments lower at 78.1% and takes 2 agents from general, though general still holds at 85.6%. P3 avoids touching the general queue and in fact lifts it to 83.7%.","P3 depends on 14 agents accepting overtime for the 12:00 hour. Payments lands exactly on 80.0%, so there is little margin if uptake falls short."],"watch":"Confirm overtime uptake before 12:00. Track payments handle time and the INC-20261118-1085 ticket. If handle time keeps climbing beyond 556 s or the slowness runs past 14:45, payments will likely fall back below target and the plan should be revisited."}
